applicableDomain: Operating Theatre Scheduling, WHO Surgical Safety Checklist & PACU Aldrete Recovery
descriptionAndPurpose: Coordinates surgical scheduling, enforces mandatory WHO Surgical Safety Checklist (Sign-In, Time-Out, Sign-Out) gates before incision, records anesthesia/operative events, and evaluates PACU Aldrete score before ward discharge.
prerequisiteConditions: Signed surgical consent, anesthesia clearance, and verified patient/site marking.
safetyChecks: WHO Surgical Safety Checklist completion mandatory prior to incision.
PACU discharge blocked until Aldrete score meets recovery threshold (>= 9).
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: Emergency trauma surgery receives EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE; elective procedures follow facility clearance policy.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Postponed surgeries retain pre-op orders and release theater slot; cancellations require surgeon attestation.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: @ClinicalAudit logs WHO checklist attestations, theater timestamps, surgical team, and PACU Aldrete score.
completionCriteria: Patient passes PACU Aldrete assessment and transfers safely to ward or ICU.
